description: Use when an agent needs recent public contract award notices with the winning companies: per award title, buyer, winner names, country, value, date and notice link. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /tenders/awards, $0.01 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

country.description: Buyer country, ISO alpha-2: EU/EEA member states and CH (TED), GB (Contracts Finder), US (USAspending). Omit with q to search all three.

q.description: Keywords (1-6 words, all must match), e.g. cloud hosting. Needed unless country is given.
